Delhi launches first Yamuna River cruise service

Delhi has launched its first recreational river cruise service on the Yamuna River. The service, named 'Namo Yamuna River Safari', offers a 6-kilometer scenic ride. The launch occurred ahead of the Chhath festival in 2026.
